Before touching ANY template file, walk every check:null condition across the 7 templates OTHER than COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json (ADMIRAL_SPINE 10, CARTOGRAPHER 5, CHARTER 10, EXECUTE_PLAN 4, EXPLORER_SPINE 10, IMPLEMENTER_PLAN 3, SCOUT 4 -- 46 conditions; COMMANDER_SPINE's own 19 stay g1's sole ownership per PLAN_CRITIC.md finding 5, no duplicate table) and assign each a bucket (1 = no locator; 2 = locator expressible, no new mechanism; 3 = artifact exists but the claim is judgment, basis territory, decision:no-basis-backfill keeps it out of scope). g1-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md: task = promote the 8 named conditions in skills/commander/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json per notes-1.md's g1 table + This run's own notes-1.md already carries a fresh, verified 19-row bucket table for COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json (g1's own ownership, not g0's -- PLAN_CRITIC.md finding 5). Promote exactly the 8 rows marked bucket-2/promote-worthy there: init.c1 (command, reads spine.json's own engine_session.status=='active'), plan.c1 (artifact, mission-frame file+status enum -- reuses w2-basis's exact shape), plan.c4 (artifact, plan-candidate files existence -- reuses w2-basis's exact shape), plan.c5 (artifact, PLAN_CRITIC.md existence -- reuses w2-basis's exact shape), plan.c2 (artifact, execute.json existence ONLY -- do not overclaim the fidelity/coverage half, which stays check:null in the statement's own unmodified wording), reconcile.c1 (artifact, file-diff evidence type, match nonempty), archive.c2 (command, git rev-parse @ == git rev-parse @{u}), archive.c3 (artifact, user-decision citing the authorizing doctrine section -- reuses the corpus's own existing 3x-used user-decision-citation convention). Leave the other 11 conditions check:null exactly as-is (init and reconcile keep bookend:true; do not touch that field). Check-kind live-ness is evaluated against THIS template's own existing (non-null) checks ONLY -- a pattern or seam decision cited from a DIFFERENT template is context for the reasoning, never eligibility for blocking (PLAN_CRITIC.md finding 3). State explicitly, per promoted condition, which of THIS SAME template's existing checks (if any) already use that kind before shipping it blocking; a first use of a kind in this specific template ships report-only with a named promotion trigger, or demotes back to check: null if the kind has no report-only shape (artifact checks have none, per w2-basis's own finding). Compact-format JSON: hand-edit skills/commander/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json as raw text, surgically -- NEVER round-trip through json.load/json.dump (destroys blame); re-validate with json.load afterward (parse-check only, never reformat). Sync .agent-work/templates/<NAME>.template.json to byte-match the edited skills/ source (copy, do not hand-retype) and confirm with `python3 scripts/check_template_overlay_freshness.py` -- must report 'none stale'. Never touch .agent-work/templates/.baseline/. Red-proof each promoted condition per decision:red-proof-each-promotion, in the style of tests/test_checklist_engine.py's CommanderSpineBasisFields class: pin PINNED_HEAD via `git rev-parse HEAD` at implementation time, skipTest (never fail) if HEAD has since moved, load the real shipped template fresh. For each promoted condition: (a) assert the promoted shape exactly; (b) assert no OTHER condition in the file changed; (c) attack with a mutation an ADVERSARY would choose, not the one the promotion's own match/command text already implies -- e.g. for an artifact check, attach a wrong-type or non-matching evidence item and assert attest() raises EngineError with the exact refusal text from checklist_engine.py ("is an artifact check; attest it by referencing...", "is type ... not the required...", "does not match required..."); for a command check, assert `advance` (never `attest`) refuses under a real-world-shaped negative fixture. Map entry point for the dispatched crew: docs/CHECK_SCRIPT_CENSUS.md (already-live check-kind inventory) and docs/CHECKLIST_SCHEMA.md's Condition/check-kind table. Dispatch via constellation-implementer.
